model_annotation: The line graph compares the performance of two network types—中介语网络 (interlanguage network) and 随机网络 (random network)—across six categories labeled A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, and 母语 (native language), with values plotted on a vertical axis ranging from 3.0 to 5.5. The red line with triangle markers represents the interlanguage network, showing a general upward trend from 3.254 at A1 to 3.685 at 母语, with a slight dip to 3.179 at B1. The blue line with star markers represents the random network, which also shows an increasing trend from 4.189 at A1 to 5.204 at 母语, with a low point of 4.030 at B1. Both networks exhibit an increase in values from A1 to 母语, with the random network consistently having higher values than the interlanguage network across all categories.
